hero.title: Never Played Padel? Perfect.
hero.desc: Everyone on our courts started exactly where you are. No experience, no gear, no problem — here's everything you need to know before your first session.

booking.title: How Booking Works
booking.step1Desc: Book your court directly through the Playtomic app or website — pick a day and time that works for you.
booking.step2Desc: Grab a racket at reception if you need one, change, and head to your court.
booking.step3Desc: Your coach or playing partners will help you get the hang of it fast — padel is easy to pick up.

alone.title: Can I Come Alone?
alone.desc: Yes. Browse Padel Haus open matches on Playtomic to join a game that suits your level, or join our community to meet players and find a partner.

gear.title: What Do I Need?
gear.racketDesc: Don't own one? No problem — rent one at reception.
gear.shoesDesc: Non-marking flat or court shoes (running shoes work fine to start), comfortable sportswear. Padel-specific shoes aren't required for your first sessions.

levels.title: Skill Levels Explained
levels.beginnerDesc: Learning the rules, court positioning, wall bounces, and basic forehands, backhands, serves, and volleys.
levels.intermediateDesc: Can sustain rallies, play more consistently, use the net, and apply simple tactics with a partner.
levels.advancedDesc: Uses precise, varied shots and the walls strategically, with strong movement, decision-making, and match experience.
levels.note: Playtomic uses a dynamic 0–7 level scale. Your starting level comes from a short assessment, then competitive match results, opponents, teammates, and rating reliability help refine it over time.
